corpus: EPA 1990 ss.45A/45AZA/45AZB (Environment Act 2021) + Separation of Waste (England) Regulations 2025 (SI 2025/140)
note: In force 31 Mar 2025 (business) / 31 Mar 2026 (household). SI 2025/140 is an exemptions instrument: metal/glass/plastic co-collection, food/garden co-collection, micro-firms (<10 FTE) exempt until 2027-03-31. Each row must populate exemptions array.
